implementation_strategy: Execute the preregistered paired GVR vs LLM-only experiment using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter and the hosted OpenAI model 'gpt-5-mini' via the 'openai_responses' provider. Use the NetConfArena-style emulation testbed (public corpus referenced in preregistration) as the deterministic simulator for final apply checks. Orchestrate all calls and logging with a CPU-based experiment harness (no local GPU). Use the adapter's shared_initial_candidate semantics (one initial generation per task reused across paired episodes) and allow up to one deterministic repair call per guarded episode as enforced by the adapter contract. Deterministic verifier and simulator components provided by the execution adapter perform all automated scoring and flagging. Adhere to the preregistered retry policy (up to 2 infra retries per task) and exclusion/sensitivity rules described in the preregistration.
task_manifest_strategy: Tasks are instantiated from the public NetConfArena-style task generator and constrained to the preregistered challenging_workflow_stress_v1 deterministic profile (included_cycle_offsets_one_based=[4,5,6,7,8], generator_cycle_length=8). Task indices are fixed prior to any model calls and listed in task_indices. Task labels include condition, cluster id, and adversarial/adversary-hash tag when applicable.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline: direct_configuration_generation_v1 (single shared initial generation per task). Guarded: generate_validate_repair_v1 (shared initial generation + deterministic verifier; if verifier FAIL then automated repair request up to 1 repair call; if still FAIL classify as unsafe per adapter rules). Deterministic normalization maps LLM outputs to canonical config ASTs before verifier ingestion.
randomisation_plan: Global experiment RNG seed = 20260801. Task-index selection follows the adapter's challenging_workflow_stress_v1 deterministic rule (fixed before outcomes). Within each batch, per-call seeds are derived deterministically from global seed and task_index. Paired episodes use the shared initial candidate per adapter contract (no independent initial generations).
caching_plan: Cache and reuse the shared initial generation and normalization artifacts per task_index to avoid duplicate initial calls across paired episodes. Cache model-call responses, verifier outputs, and artifact hashes; all caches keyed by (task_index, seed_metadata).
failure_recovery_plan: Automatic deterministic retry for infrastructure/API failures up to 2 attempts per model call. If both attempts fail mark pair as infra-failed and treat per preregistration: exclude from primary analysis (complete_pair_primary) and include in sensitivity analysis as unsafe (failure-as-zero). Verifier–simulator inconsistencies are flagged automatically as 'possible false-safe' and excluded from primary analysis (included in sensitivity analyses). All failures logged with cause codes and hashes.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (v1.0) per-task record: {study_id, task_index, cluster_id, condition, initial_generation_text, repair_attempts:[texts], final_output_text, verifier_result:{PASS|FAIL, checks_passed}, simulator_apply_result:{safe_apply|unsafe_apply}, unsafe_apply_flag (binary), flags:{possible_false_safe,adversarial,infra_failure}, model_call_count, per-call_seed_metadata, per-call_latency_ms, timestamps, artifact_hashes}
estimated_compute_notes: Totals derived from adapter semantics: one shared initial generation per task (240 calls) plus at most one guarded repair call per task (≤240 calls) → maximum_model_calls = 240 + 240 = 480 (explicit). Estimated_model_calls = 360 (expected case) = 240 initial + 120 expected repairs (average repair rate assumed 50% for budget planning). All totals respect the adapter maximum_model_calls = task_count * 2 = 480 and the capability manifest maximum_planned_model_calls = 10000. Wall-clock execution planned within the 7-day limit using hosted APIs and 24 execution batches; retries are included in the maximum_model_calls cap.
